title: Desktop composer skill/MCP suggestion caches survive a profile or connection switch

candidates.author: pierrenode
candidates.merges_clean_on_pinned_main: false: textual conflict in profile.ts $activeGatewayProfile.subscribe block (main added invalidateProfileListFetches()); resolved mechanically by keeping both. Semantic problem after merge: new import edge profile.ts -> suggestion-providers/{skill,mcp}.ts closes an import cycle back into profile.ts via app/chat/composer -> slash-refs.ts -> lib/desktop-slash-commands.ts -> lib/slash-completion-cache.ts
candidates.has_tests: yes: 2 tests in apps/desktop/src/store/profile.test.ts, both mock the suggestion-provider modules (which hides the cycle)
candidates.approach: call invalidateMcpSuggestionIndex() + invalidateSkillSuggestionIndex() inside the profile.ts $activeGatewayProfile real-change block

regression_test.source: new (behavioural; skill half adapted from fork #38 skill-cache.test.ts, MCP half new)
tests: suggestion caches on profile switch > does not offer the previous profile skill or MCP pills after switching profiles
suggestion caches on profile switch > keeps the caches when the profile is re-set to the same key
suggestion caches on connection switch with an unchanged profile key > does not offer the previous connection skill or MCP pills
regression_test.contract: After a switch to another backend (profile switch, or a connection switch that keeps the same profile key), the skill and MCP draft providers answer from the new backend, not from their 5-minute module caches; a same-key re-set keeps the cache.

main.detail: 2 failed | 1 passed: profile switch still offers ['pr-ready'] and ['linear'] (expected []), connection switch same; same-key test passes.

85253.detail: Profile-switch contract passes (skill + MCP) and same-key passes; same-profile-key connection switch still fails (out of its scope). Merged onto af92ea8e it introduces an import cycle: 62 of 91 desktop test files that import store/profile fail to load vs 1 on main (61 new; TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'subscribe') at lib/slash-completion-cache.ts:99, plus mock-chain errors). With the regression test importing store/profile before the providers, the test file itself fails to load the same way. Static ESM order check from src/main.tsx shows profile.ts is entered first, so the renderer would likely hit the same TDZ at boot (Electron boot NOT_TESTED). tsc -p . clean.

fork#38 rebuilt (reference, not a candid.detail: skill.ts subscription + gateway-switch wipe call: skill assertions pass for profile and connection switch; MCP assertions fail (fork does not touch mcp.ts).

provider-subscription design (reference,.detail: fork #38 hunks + MCP twin (mcp.ts $activeGatewayProfile subscription + invalidateMcpSuggestionIndex() in wipeSessionListsForGatewaySwitch), +51/-0, 3 files: 3/3; 91 profile importers + suggestion-providers + gateway-switch.test.ts 96/97 files, 1251 tests (same single sparse-checkout fixture failure as main); no back-edge into profile.ts.

adjacent_tests.result: main 90/91 (use-session-actions.test.tsx fails on a ../tests/fixtures import missing from the sparse worktree, pre-existing artifact); #85253 merged 29/91 (61 new load failures); provider-subscription design 96/97 (same artifact only). profile.test.ts with #85253: 27/27.

exclude_reason: No correct candidate. The only open PR, #85253, fixes the profile-switch half but, merged onto af92ea8e, its profile.ts -> suggestion-providers import closes a cycle back into profile.ts (via lib/slash-completion-cache.ts), which makes 61 additional desktop test files fail to load (62/91 vs 1/91 on main), and it does not cover a connection switch that keeps the same profile key. Making it sound means moving its only production hunk into provider-module subscriptions, which is a redesign of the PR, not a fold-in.
notes: Support rather than compete: a review note on #85253 should report the cycle (61 test-file load failures on current main; its own tests mock the providers and hide it) and suggest the verified shape: subscribe to $activeGatewayProfile inside skill.ts and mcp.ts (the existing slash-completion-cache.ts pattern, as in fork #38) and call both invalidators in wipeSessionListsForGatewaySwitch() (fork #38 hunk, extended to MCP) for same-profile-key connection switches. Design diff and test saved in the evidence dir (provider-subscription-design.diff, switch-cache.test.ts). This contradicts the fork-38 verdict note that #85253's profile.ts placement is the better one: that was true at its Aug-13 base, not on current main. No other open PR invalidates these caches (searched invalidateSkillSuggestionIndex, invalidateMcpSuggestionIndex, suggestion-providers, wipeSessionListsForGatewaySwitch; #82823/#89915/#104680/#106041 touch neighbouring files but not these caches). Co-authored-by if the design is later carried: pierrenode <298902573+pierrenode@users.noreply.github.com>, Kevin Rajan <7121943+kvnloo@users.noreply.github.com>.

issue: #81160 / #81161 (carrier's issues); the defect itself has no issue: reviewDiff/review_diff (unstaged) renders a clean or stale-staged tracked file as a new-file all-add
title: Review pane unstaged diff synthesizes a 'new file mode' all-add for tracked files with an empty unstaged diff (Electron + Python twin)

candidates.author: thelonewander3r (commit author Eman <eman1369a@gmail.com>)
candidates.mergeable_github: CONFLICTING (DIRTY); labels type/bug, P2, comp/desktop, comp/cli, sweeper:risk-compatibility
candidates.merges_clean_on_pinned_main: false: git-review-ops.ts x2 (main replaced the raw execFile --no-index call with execGit from no-console-git; PR replaced it with untrackedDiff) and git-review-ops.test.ts x2 (main's reviewCreatePr import + file-wide execFile mock vs PR's appended tests). Mechanical resolution builds and passes the regression test, but the PR's new helpers still spawn git with raw execFile, so 8 of its own tests fail under main's execFile mock until ported to execGit (+21/-22).
candidates.has_tests: yes: +288 in git-review-ops.test.ts, diff-lines.test.ts, tests/hermes_cli/test_web_git_review_pathspecs.py (none for the tracked-file case)
candidates.approach: resolve untracked rows through `git ls-files --others --exclude-standard` in both reviewDiff (Electron) and review_diff (Python); a tracked file resolves to nothing, so ''. Also literalizes all pathspecs, expands untracked directories, and changes staged rows to diff HEAD..worktree.
